name: Cafe Phoenix am Hornplatzl
kurzbeschreibung: Café Phoenix at Hornplatzl in Tirol Welcome to Café Phoenix at Hornplatzl, a charming café nestled in the heart of Tirol, where tradition meets modern flair.
beschreibung: The Cafe Phoenix am Hornplatzl in Kitzbühel is a charming town café delighting guests with homemade cakes, specialty coffees, and an inviting atmosphere. Visitors can relax with a book or meet friends over classic Austrian pastries, from delicate curd strudel to rich Sachertorte. Lovingly decorated seating and warm hospitality create a welcoming ambiance right in vibrant Kitzbühel.
